arguments.summary: Completed a refinance analysis for Meadow Commerce as of 2026-08-31. Underwritten EGI $895,320, NOI before reserves $666,860, and NCF $652,460. Mechanical value at 6.50% cap is $10.26MM. Loan sizing per term sheet: LTV limit $6.16MM (binding), DSCR limit $6.62MM, Debt yield limit $6.87MM. Maximum loan $6.156MM; first-year IO debt service at 6.10% is $375.5k. Net cash to borrower after 1% fee and $55k costs against a $3.6MM payoff is approx. $2.439MM. Combined downside (EGI -5%, sizing +100 bps) yields $5.575MM maximum (DSCR binding). Delivered outputs: downloadable XLSX underwriting workbook with live inputs and sensitivity (artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx) and a concise internal financing memorandum PDF (artifacts/memorandum-v1.pdf). All key fields reported with page/row citations. No missing files. Insurance renewal remains unverified; renewal option not exercised.
